*comment ====================================================================================
*comment THE CORD & KETTLE: Langston's general store, reached from the town hub.
*comment Ansel Reed sells the same shared general-goods pool as Timbermouth's Marlow and
*comment Alderford's Nessa Pell. Catalog-backed blocks are generated by tools/gen_gear.js.
*comment Hours are decided by Langston/langston.txt: Morning through Dusk, closed Hallowday.
*comment ====================================================================================

*label lg_store
*set lg_store_seen true
*set minutes_to_pass 5
*set time_advance_call_id "lg_store_1"
*gosub_scene Langston/langston lg_walk_time
*goto lg_store_front

*label lg_store_front
*gosub_scene Langston/langston lg_hours
*if (not(lg_ok_store))
  *set shop_open ""
  *goto_scene Langston/langston lg_store_closed
*set current_district "langston"
*set scenery_subplace "cord_and_kettle"
*gosub lg_store_open_panel
*temp lg_store_first false
*if (not(met_ansel_reed))
  *set lg_store_first true
*set met_ansel_reed true
[b]◈ THE CORD & KETTLE[/b]
*line_break
*gosub lg_store_layers

*set wait_ok_page page_id
*choice
  # Look over the shelves.
    *goto lg_store_stock
  *if (lg_store_has_sale)
    # Put something on the counter to sell.
      *goto lg_store_sell
  # Step back out into Langston.
    *set shop_open ""
    *goto_scene Langston/langston lg_return
  # ⚖ Settle up the trade panel.
    *goto lg_store_settle
  *comment GEN:BEGIN place_steps home:langston -- generated by tools/gen_city_settlements.js from its registry; edit the registry, not this block
  # ⇥ [pvgo:home:langston]
    *set shop_open ""
    *goto_scene Langston/langston lg_return
  *comment GEN:END place_steps home:langston

*comment ── LAYERS: the store uses the same place, sky and activity contract as Langston's hub.
*label lg_store_layers
*gosub lg_store_place
*gosub lg_store_sky
*gosub lg_store_street
*return

*comment ── LAYER 1: PLACE ── Permanent shop geography, stock and sensory character.
*label lg_store_place
The Cord & Kettle occupies a narrow corner shop just off the market square. A painted sign above the frontage shows a coil of cord looped through the handle of a black kettle. Inside, shelves climb to the ceiling between dark timber posts. Rope and cord hang by thickness from pegs, lanterns and pots occupy the upper shelves, and canvas rolls, tool kits and travelling supplies fill the lower racks. The air smells of hemp, lamp oil, soap and seasoned wood.
*return

*comment ── LAYER 2: SKY ── Outdoor weather and light as experienced inside, plus weather memory.
*label lg_store_sky
*if (weather = "Rain")
  Rain stipples the front windows and darkens the sill beneath them.
*elseif (weather = "Storm")
  Rain drums against the shutters while the hanging goods sway slightly on their hooks.
*elseif (weather = "Fog")
  The windows show only a pale blur beyond the shelves.
*elseif ((weather = "Snow") or (weather = "Sleet"))
  Meltwater gathers on a folded sacking mat inside the threshold.
*elseif (weather = "Blizzard")
  The shutters are fastened against the weather, and lamps burn over the counter.
*elseif (weather = "Clear")
  *if (time_period = "Dusk")
    Low light reaches across the shelves while Ansel lights the counter lamps one by one.
  *else
    Clear light through the front windows catches the brass lanterns and pale coils of new cord.
*else
  Grey light lies across the counter, leaving the upper shelves in shadow.

*if ((ground_state = "sodden") and (not(weather_wet)))
  Old mud still darkens the sacking mat after days of rain in the square.
*elseif ((ground_state = "wet") and (not(weather_wet)))
  Damp marks remain on the mat and floorboards from the last rain.
*return

*comment ── LAYER 3: STREET ── Keeper and customer activity by time, weather and the Wolves investigation.
*label lg_store_street
*if (lg_store_first)
  A broad, greying man stands behind the counter, winding measured cord around a wooden gauge. He finishes the length before setting it aside. "Ansel Reed," he says. "If you need it for the road, the camp, or a small repair, it is probably here. If it is not, I will tell you plainly."
*else
  Ansel Reed works behind the counter, measuring cord against the marks cut into its edge.

*if (street_life = "empty")
  No customers have challenged the weather. The shop is quiet except for the shutters and the small sounds of Ansel's work.
*elseif (street_life = "thin")
  Only a few customers come in from the poor weather, shaking out outer layers before asking for oil, cord and repair supplies.
*elseif (time_period = "Morning")
  Early customers collect lamp oil, tool rolls and measured lengths of rope before beginning their day's work.
*elseif (time_period = "Midday")
  The narrow aisles stay busy with townspeople comparing household supplies and wagoners replacing gear worn on the road.
*elseif (time_period = "Afternoon")
  Trade comes in short bursts as errands cross the market square and Ansel restores sold goods from the upper shelves.
*else
  Dusk thins the shop. Ansel finishes the last measures of cord and begins drawing the most valuable goods away from the windows.

*if (((wol_quest_stage = "asked") or (wol_quest_stage = "offered")) or (wol_quest_stage = "active"))
  Talk among the customers repeatedly falls back to Maybelline's killing, though voices lower whenever the door opens.
*return

*label lg_store_stock
*gosub lg_store_open_panel
You walk the shelves. Rope and finer cord hang in measured coils. Pitch-dipped torches stand in a clay jar, lanterns and tool rolls hang from hooks, and a lute rests in a padded wall cradle. Flint and steel, chalk, soap and lamp oil occupy the counter shelves. Below them sit water jugs, cooking pots, camp kits, waxed cloth and parcels of trail rations, each marked with a price.
*choice
  # Step back to the counter.
    *goto lg_store_front
  # ⚖ Settle up the trade panel.
    *goto lg_store_settle
  *comment GEN:BEGIN place_steps home:langston -- generated by tools/gen_city_settlements.js from its registry; edit the registry, not this block
  # ⇥ [pvgo:home:langston]
    *goto lg_store_front
  *comment GEN:END place_steps home:langston

*label lg_store_sell
Ansel clears a square of counter and spreads a piece of canvas over it. He checks each item you offer before naming a price.
*gosub lg_store_open_panel
*choice
  # Take everything back off the counter.
    *goto lg_store_front
  # ⚖ Settle up the trade panel.
    *goto lg_store_settle
  *comment GEN:BEGIN place_steps home:langston -- generated by tools/gen_city_settlements.js from its registry; edit the registry, not this block
  # ⇥ [pvgo:home:langston]
    *goto lg_store_front
  *comment GEN:END place_steps home:langston

*label lg_store_open_panel
*set shop_open "lgstore"
*set shop_rows ""
*temp lg_any_sale ((((((has_hemp_rope) or (has_pitch_torch)) or ((has_lamp_oil) or (has_hooded_lantern))) or (((has_tool_kit) or (has_shovel)) or ((has_lute) or (has_tinderbox)))) or ((((has_water_jug) or (has_cooking_pot)) or ((has_chalk_sticks) or (has_camp_kit))) or ((has_waxed_oilcloth) or (has_lye_soap)))) or (has_trail_rations))
*set lg_store_has_sale lg_any_sale
*comment GEN:BEGIN lgstore_panel_rows
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "hemp_rope~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "pitch_torch~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "lamp_oil~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "hooded_lantern~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "tool_kit~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "shovel~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "lute~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "tinderbox~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "water_jug~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "cooking_pot~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "chalk_sticks~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "camp_kit~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "waxed_oilcloth~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "lye_soap~|")
*set shop_rows (shop_rows & "trail_rations~|")
*comment GEN:END lgstore_panel_rows
*return

*label lg_store_cart_pass
*comment GEN:BEGIN lgstore_cart_pass
*set shop_buyer "general"
*set gear_shop "lgstore_sell"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "hemp_rope"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "pitch_torch"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "lamp_oil"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "hooded_lantern"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "tool_kit"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "tinderbox"
*if (cart_sell_water_jug > 0)
  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "water_jug"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "cooking_pot"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "waxed_oilcloth"

  *gosub_scene equipment shop_cart_sell "lye_soap"

*label lg_store_settle
*if (not(currency_txn_locked)) or (not(locked_currency_txn_page_id = page_id))
  *gosub_scene equipment shop_begin
  *gosub lg_store_cart_pass
  *gosub_scene equipment shop_check
  *if (shop_verdict = "ok")
    *set shop_mode "apply"
    *gosub lg_store_cart_pass
    *set currency_add_amount (shop_tot_credit - shop_tot_cost)
    *gosub_scene economy currency_add
  *else
    *set shop_mode "clear"
    *gosub lg_store_cart_pass
  *set currency_txn_locked true
  *set locked_currency_txn_page_id page_id
*if (shop_verdict = "empty")
  Ansel finds nothing set aside to reckon and returns to his measuring.
  *page_break Back to the counter…
  *goto lg_store_after_stock
*if (shop_verdict = "short")
  You count your coin against the marked prices and come up short. Ansel returns the goods to their places.
  *page_break Back to the counter…
  *goto lg_store_after_stock
*if ((shop_tot_bought > 0) and (shop_tot_sold > 0))
  Ansel checks both groups of goods, writes two short columns on a slate and settles the difference.
*elseif (shop_tot_bought > 0)
  Ansel checks each shelf mark and sets your purchases on the canvas.
*else
  Ansel checks each item for wear and counts out your coin.
*if (shop_tot_sold > 0)
  *line_break
  [b][💰 Sold: ${shop_sold_list} for ${shop_credit_desc}][/b]
*if (shop_tot_bought > 0)
  *line_break
  [b][🛒 Bought: ${shop_recv} for ${shop_cost_desc}][/b]
*set hours_to_pass 0
*set minutes_to_pass shop_tot_minutes
*if (shop_tot_sold > 0)
  *set minutes_to_pass (minutes_to_pass + 5)
*set time_advance_call_id "lg_store_trade"
*gosub_scene calendar advance_time
*gosub_scene calendar recalc_hp_from_neglect
*if (hp_current <= 0)
  *set death_cause "starvation"
  *if (neglect_damage_fatigue > neglect_damage_hunger)
    *set death_cause "exhaustion"
  *goto_scene death death_screen
*page_break Back to the counter…
*goto lg_store_after_stock

*label lg_store_after
*gosub_scene Langston/langston lg_hours
*if (lg_ok_store)
  *goto lg_store_front
*set shop_open ""
*goto_scene Langston/langston lg_store_closed

*label lg_store_after_stock
*goto lg_store_after
